* Faster app start, since non-essential reader resources load later.

[ Compatibility ]
- Verified compatibility with Android 8–14 for the updated crash-reporting stack.

[ Warning ]

-------------- [ PATCH UPDATE ] -----------
Date: 7/28/2026

[ New Features ]
- Auto-Backup: optional toggle in Backup & Restore; silently creates backup on close/background. Auto-backups (tagged "auto", latest 3 kept) reuse the manual export pipeline and auto-clean older ones.
- Per-novel write lock: prevents concurrent saves (e.g. progress autosave during app resume) from colliding on the same file.
- Automatic cleanup of orphaned `.tmp` files from interrupted atomic writes.
- Low-storage warning before novel download: warns if <200 MB free, shows exact free space, allows cancel or continue.
- Update-available badge: a dot on the Settings tab icon when a newer version is available.
- Backup size estimate: the "Label this backup" step now shows estimated size (before compression).
- Automatic chapter download retry: failed chapters retry up to 3 times, then skip; all skipped chapters retried again (3 attempts each) at the end before finalizing.
- "Recently Added" tag on library cards: unread novels added in the last 24 hours show "Recently Added" instead of "Unread", reverting automatically after 24h.
- "Last Read: Xd" tag: novels with reading progress not opened in 2+ days show the days since last read, replacing the normal status badge.

[ Fixes ]
- Fixed a race condition where overlapping saves sharing the same temp filename caused a `moveAsync` rejection.
- Fixed orphaned `.tmp` files left by failed atomic writes, which previously wasted storage over time.
- Fixed the library card "Continue" button: it now jumps directly to the reader at the last-read chapter. Novels without progress still show "Read" and open the detail page.
- Fixed the reader's close button returning to the library instead of the novel detail page when opened via "Continue". It now always returns to the detail screen.
- Fixed auto-scroll speed changes requiring pause/resume to apply. Adjusting speed while auto-scroll is running now takes effect immediately.

[ Changes ]
- Changed default library tab on app open from "All" to "Reading".
- The filter tab bar now auto-scrolls to keep the active tab centered, whether selected by tap or swipe.

[ Improvements ]
- Atomic file writes now serialized per destination path, queuing overlapping writes to avoid races.
- Failed library writes now clean up partial state automatically.
- Improved the chapter list empty state on the novel detail screen with an icon, clearer text, and a "Go to Updates" button.
- Minor internal cleanup across reader, settings, and library context files to reduce `any` usage and tighten type coverage.

--------PATCH START ------
----- NovelDR.v4.0.0rev487 ---
DATE: JULY 25, 2026

[ CAUTION ]
 ⚠️ This is a major storage upgrade. The app will automatically migrate your library to a new, faster, and more reliable format on first launch.

Please ensure you have a recent backup (via Settings → Backup & Restore) before updating. Downgrading to an older version after this update will require restoring from that backup.

[ Warning ]
- The app may be unstable on Android 16 and newer devices due to upstream React Native rendering issues. Mitigations have been added, but occasional crashes or freezes may still occur.

[ Compatibility ]
- Added an Android 16 rapid-tap guard to reduce scheduler/Skia crashes and warn users before instability occurs.


[ New Features ]
- Re-added NovelArrow to the Download tab.
- Added Notifee-powered background TTS with persistent playback and media controls.
- Added a TTS AutoNext button that appears only while TTS is active.
- Added an elapsed-time timer to the Backup & Restore screen during backup and restore operations.
- Added a collapsible quick-actions button cluster to the Reader (toggle arrow to show/hide the guidebook, background-playback setup, and TTS buttons).
- Added an optional Background Playback Setup guide in the Reader, walking users through notification permission, battery optimization exemption, and OEM autostart settings (only shown on devices that expose one) to prevent narration from being killed in the background.

[ Fixes ]
- Fixed Site Health Checker auto-recheck to prevent stale source status.
- Fixed NovelBinCC scraper registration and synopsis extraction.
- Fixed a visual flicker on the Settings screen.
- Fixed Reader TypeScript build errors and notification trigger compatibility.
- Fixed TTS auto-scroll drift and a related runtime ReferenceError.
- Fixed TTS stopping when the app is backgrounded by introducing a foreground service.
- Fixed a race condition where the library reload button (and pull-to-refresh) could read a partially-restored library while a backup restore was still writing files.
- Fixed `FileSystem.moveAsync` silently failing to overwrite `novel_library_v1.json` on Android, which could break every atomic library write after the first.
- Fixed a directory-creation race during parallel chapter restore that could abort the entire restore when multiple chapters for the same novel wrote at once.
- Fixed backup restore aborting completely when a single chapter or cover file failed to write; failures are now logged individually and the restore continues.
- Fixed the "library has been refreshed" message shown after a restore — refreshing is now manual, so the message now points to the reload button / pull-to-refresh instead.
- Fixed a bug in the one‑time library migration that could reorder novels due to concurrent writes; migration now preserves the original order from the monolithic JSON.
- Fixed TTS narration silently stopping mid-chapter when the background thread stalled (Doze / OEM throttling) with no error shown; added a stall watchdog that retries once automatically, then surfaces a "Narration stalled — tap to resume" recovery option instead of failing silently.

[ Improvements ]
- Improved `webviewBridge` compatibility with Cloudflare-protected sources.
- Increased `http.ts` request timeout from 15s to 50s to reduce premature timeouts.
- Increased `webviewBridge.ts` timeout from 10s to 30s for improved loading reliability.
- Improved reader formatting for cleaner paragraphs, system messages, rule headings, stat blocks, and scene separators.
- Improved TTS sentence mapping to keep narration and highlighting synchronized.
- Improved TTS rendering performance through memoization and optimized paragraph rendering.
- Improved TTS auto-scroll to follow the currently spoken sentence instead of the paragraph.
- Improved reader stability with additional guards and safety checks.
- Improved scroll position restoration for more reliable reading-session resume.
- Improved Max Chapters to default to 30 when left blank, matching Start Chapter's default fallback.
- Updated the Max Chapters input placeholder to show 30 instead of "All".
- Removed dead unlimited-chapters fallback logic now that Max Chapters always resolves to a number.
- Improved backup restore speed by writing chapters and covers in parallel (12 at a time) instead of one file at a time.
- Improved restore activity log performance by batching UI updates every 25 files instead of updating on every single file.
- Improved library file writes to be atomic (staged to a `.tmp` file, then moved into place) to prevent a corrupted library index if the app closes mid-write.
- Refactored library storage to per‑novel files with a lightweight index, eliminating write amplification from rewriting the entire library on every small mutation.
- Added a one‑time migration that splits the old monolithic `novel_library_v1.json` into individual novel files; migration runs in parallel with concurrency=12 for speed.
- Added live progress reporting during migration, showing a running counter and partial‑success status if some novels fail.
- Added Sentry error reporting to the migration step to capture individual novel write failures, aiding debugging of rare disk errors.
- Updated backup/restore to use the new per‑novel file structure (via `bulkWriteNovels`), improving restore speed and atomicity while preserving library order.
- Fixed TypeScript errors in Settings related to `SortOrder` type casting and missing `content` property in chapter fallback.
- Improved the Restore Backup screen: moved it into a centered popup modal with a virtualized (FlatList) backup list and activity log, preventing UI lag when opening a long backup list or watching restore progress.
- Improved backup restore: the restored library now stays in memory until the user manually pulls-to-refresh or taps reload, eliminating a brief window where partially-restored data could appear on the Library screen mid-restore.
-

body:
✨ [ NEW ]
  
- " ZIP‑only backups " —  New backups are now always created as a single .zip file, built via a streaming, memory‑safe export (chapters written in bounded NDJSON parts, covers compressed and copied directly) rather than one giant in‑memory JSON blob.

- " Dual‑format restore " — The restore flow supports both ZIP (v5+) and legacy JSON (v4 and earlier), from the on‑device backup list or the file picker.

- " Share button restored " – The backup completion alert now includes a “Share Backup” button to instantly share the generated `.zip` file.

- " Native crash reporting (Sentry) " — Native crash capture wired in at app launch, plus Session Replay (10% of normal sessions, 100% of sessions that hit an error).  

- " Novel Cover compression " — Covers are resized/compressed via `expo-image-manipulator` before being packed into the backup, instead of embedded as raw base64.

- "Check for Updates " —  Added the button 'Check for Updates` in the Settings to manually check the if there's a new version or the update was skipped.

- "Notif Bell Update" — Added a Notif bell icon just on top of the Reload button, it will only appear once there's a new update or has been manually triggered by the `Check for Updates` in the Settings tab.

- " Chapter Deletion " — Added a chapter deletion system that deletes chapters properly and have the same flow as deleting a novel in the Library tab.

- [ SELF UPDATER IMPLEMENTATION ]
     - Implemented `downloadApk` using `expo-file-system`'s `createDownloadResumable`.
     
     - Added an update modal UI component, it looks like a notification bell, to notify users when a new version is available, showing version info, changelog, and a download/install action.
     
     - Implemented `downloadApk` using expo-file-system's `createDownloadResumable`, with progress tracking for the modal's download state.
     
     - Implemented installApk using FileSystem.getContentUriAsync + expo-intent-launcher to trigger the Android package installer directly from the app, and for Android 7+ compatibility.
     
     - Added the `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES` permission to `app.config.js`, since Android blocks "install from unknown sources" for sideloaded apps without it.
     
     - Connected `downloadApk/installApk` into `useUpdateChecker.ts` so the update flow triggers automatically on version check.

     
 - [ CHAPTER LIMITER ]
     - Added a shared `useChapterLimiter` hook and `ChapterLimitModal` component.
     
     - Thresholds: caution at 200 chapters, danger at 250+, hard cap at 300.
     
     - Wired into both `add.tsx` and `updates.tsx`.

⚡ [ IMPROVEMENTS ]  

- " Consolidated code " – Removed `collectAppData()` and `exportBackupJSON()`, replaced with a single `exportBackup()` function for the streaming ZIP export.  

- " File picker extended " – Now accepts both `application/json` and `application/zip` MIME types, making it easier to import any backup.

- "Silent skip guard"  – Update's chapter-skip logging (`SKIPPED: already fetched this run` / `SKIPPED: already in library`) no longer prints per-chapter — the skip guard now runs silently in the background.

- "Faster stuck-loop detection"  – Added a consecutive-skip counter (`MAX_CONSECUTIVE_SKIPS = 5`) that breaks the update loop immediately once 5 chapters in a row are skipped without a real download, instead of waiting on the much higher `ITERATION_CEILING` (`maxCh × 5 + 50`).

- "Clear stop message" – When the guard trips, the log now shows a single clean line: `STOPPED: Update has stopped without downloading anything new. The source's "next chapter" link likely nonexistent.`

- "Progress-aware reset" – The skip counter resets to 0 the moment a real chapter (new or gap-fill) actually downloads, so long legitimate resume runs over already-downloaded chapters aren't falsely flagged as stuck.  

- [ BATTERY DRAIN FIX ]
      - Traced excessive battery usage to `splitSentencesWithLineBreaks` and TTS highlight matching running on every single render frame.
      - Fixed `useMemo` and a `ttsToRenderKeyMap` for `O(1)` lookups, for TTS render optimization.

- [ UPDATE CHECKER FIX ]
     - Fixed a bug where the app could never actually tell what version was currently installed, so it kept thinking every release — even older ones — was a new update.
     
     - The update check now correctly recognizes the version you already have, so you won't get repeat "update available" prompts or be offered a downgrade disguised as an update.  
     


🗑️ [ REMOVED / REPLACED ]  

- " Removed JSON backup path " – The old `exportBackupJSON()` and its supporting code are no longer used.  

- " Old single‑blob JSON export path removed " — the original `collectAppData()` (full library + chapters + base64 covers built in memory, then double‑copied via JSON.stringify) is gone; this was the likely source of the OOM crashes on large libraries.

## NovelDR v2.12.12 

---

### ✨ [ NEW ]
- Added `Margins` with 3 presets: _Compact, Comfortable, & Spacious._

- Added reader `backgrounds` with 11 presets (solid & gradient): _Parchment, Night, Forest, Ocean, Rose, Slate, Dusk, Dawn, Mist, Moss, Ember,_ or keep the default by choosing _None_ which automatically switched back to the app's theme and font colors. 

- Added adaptive text colors to adjust automatically for perfect contrast.

- Added an option to set any image from gallery as a _custom reading background._

- Custom background images are stored locally; they will not be backed up to any cloud storage.

- Added a function when tapping the progress bar to jump anywhere in the chapter.

- Added UI overhaul to make the TOC display the current reading progress in percentage.

- Added a dynamic search function inside the TOC to quickly search chapters by title, displaying results while typing.

### ⚡ [ IMPROVEMENTS ]
- Reworked the skipping logic to work just like the Update Tab.

- Improved LNW Scraping by adding diagnostics and support for direct link downloads.

- Reduced skip delay from 200ms to 50ms per chapter, increasing skipping speed further.

- Reworked the Developer Profile modal display.

- Reworked the Credits and Acknowledgements modal display.

- **Control panel** now a floating bottom‑sheet overlay — no longer pushes content down.

- **Progress bar** relocated to just above bottom navigation for better visibility.

- **TTS highlight map** precomputed with `useMemo` — no longer recalculated inside every render.

- **Reading progress** saved every 3 seconds via `debounce` instead of only `on unmount`.

- **TTS scroll** now follows the highlighted sentence using paragraph `onLayout` y‑positions.

- Auto‑scroll stops when TTS starts; TTS stops when auto‑scroll starts.

- Background preferences now persist across sessions via `reader_bg.json`.

- `ImageBackground` fills screen by width/height with `resizeMode="cover"`.

- **Added `splitIntoReadableParagraphs()`** to normalize `\r\n`, tabs, blank lines, and single‑newline chapter text.

### 🗑️ [ REMOVED / REPLACED ]
- Removed dead `forceTopRef` code.

- **Replaced outer content `<Text>` wrapper with `<View>`** and rendered each paragraph as its own sibling `<Text>` with `marginBottom` — spacing is now actually respected.

### 🐞 [ BUG FIXES ]
- Fixed covers occasionally saving as corrupted or empty files.

- Fixed cover file extension always being saved as `.jpg` regardless of source format.

- Resolved rare crashes when switching chapters while TTS was active.

- Corrected text color behavior on gradient backgrounds.

- Fixed “Next Chapter” preloading sometimes failing on the first attempt.

- Prevented TTS from continuing after chapter change or app backgrounding.

- `splitIntoSentences` no longer splits on commas/semicolons — sentence-ending punctuation only (`.!?…`), preventing choppy TTS fragments.

- Much smarter paragraph and sentence detection that handles dialogue, punctuation, line breaks, and special characters (→, …, —) for a natural reading flow.

- Previously loaded chapters are stored temporarily in cache to make switching chapters flow seamlessly.

- Optimized scrolling and text rendering; old cache entries are automatically cleared after 30 minutes.

- Improved the persistence settings of the reader so that font size, line spacing, margins, auto‑scroll speed, background choice, and TTS preferences are saved automatically.

### ♿ [ ACCESSIBILITY ]
- Added haptic feedback for all major interactions.

- Added visual feedback on press for all touch targets.

- Long‑press interactions are clearly documented in the TTS guide (book button) modal.

- Added a `Scroll to Top [ ↑ ]` button in the reader to scroll directly to the very start of the chapter.

# 📚 Novel DR — v1.4.0 (rev147)

## Release Date: May 7, 2026
### Codename: "The Foundation Update"

---

## 🏗️ Core Storage

· Migrated entire library storage from AsyncStorage to expo-file-system for better data persistence across app updates.
· Added automatic data migration on first launch with visual progress tracking.
· Added multi-location data recovery to find novels after app updates.
· Added one-time initialization flag so migration only runs once.

---

## 📖 Chapter Management

· Added automatic chapter number extraction from titles to sort chapters correctly regardless of download order.
· Added chapterNumber field to Chapter type for reliable sorting without repeated title parsing.
· Enhanced extractChapterNumber to support multiple title patterns (decimal chapters, Roman numerals, etc.).
· Fixed Table of Contents display where chapters downloaded out of order would appear incorrectly.
· Migrated to individual chapter file storage for 3,000+ chapters support with 85%+ RAM reduction.

---

## 📥 Download & Updates

· Added chapter number extraction during download for future sorting reliability.
· Replaced spammy "every 30 chapters" skip logs with cleaner milestone progress at 25%, 50%, and 75% completion.
· Added final summary log showing total skipped chapters and destination chapter.
· Fixed chapter sorting to merge existing and new chapters by actual chapter number instead of download sequence.
· Sorted downloaded chapters by chapter number before saving to library.
· Added skip progress logging with milestone tracking.

---

## 📚 Library Screen

· Added manual refresh button in header with theme-aware accent color.
· Added pull-to-refresh functionality to force reload library from storage.
· Added swipe gesture support for switching between filter tabs.
· Added search filtering by title or author with batch selection mode.

---

## 📖 Reader Screen

· Fixed gear icon crashing with "Something went wrong" by removing recursive settings calls.
· Fixed autoscroll not working with smooth continuous scrolling at configurable speeds.
· Fixed chapter flashing when navigating by persisting previous content during loads.
· Added AsyncStorage fallback chain for loading legacy chapter content.
· Fixed TOC chapter sorting with robust number extraction from multiple patterns.

---

## 💾 Backup & Restore

· Added complete backup system saving all novels, chapters, progress, and settings to a single file.
· Added real-time Activity Log showing each backup and restore step with progress.
· Added backup file management with share, delete, and metadata preview.
· Added legacy AsyncStorage data capture in backups for full compatibility.
· Added Import from File option for external backup restoration.

---

## 🎨 UI & Export

· Added "⋮" menu button to novel detail screen header with export options.
· Added 5 export formats: TXT, EPUB, DOCX, RTF, and MOBI.
· Added animated initialization screen with step-by-step progress on first launch.
· Optimized chapter list with FlatList virtualization for smooth scrolling.

---

## 🛠️ Library Context

· Added refreshLibrary method to manually reload novel data from file system.
· Updated saveChapterContent to accept optional chapterNumber parameter.
· Preserved chapterNumber field when saving and loading library metadata.
· Separated chapter metadata from content for memory-efficient browsing.

---

## 🎯 Bug Fixes

· Fixed issue where chapters without numbers in titles would break sorting.
· Fixed duplicate chapter entries when updating novels with existing chapters.
· Fixed data loss when updating from previous app versions.
· Fixed chapter content not loading from AsyncStorage legacy data.
· Fixed backup not saving all chapters from multiple novels.
· Fixed reader settings not persisting after app restart.
· Fixed progress bar not updating correctly during max chapter limits.

---
